questions.title: How does the iterative fastText pipeline expand the size of the DeepSeekMath Corpus?
questions.question_body: In Section 2.1 the authors describe an iterative process where an initial fastText model trained on OpenWebMath seed examples is used to recall candidate pages from Common Crawl, after which highly scored pages are added back into the seed corpus for a second round of training. I am unclear why repeating this cycle increases both diversity and quantity of mathematical content rather than merely re‑sampling already‑captured pages. Does adding manually annotated URLs from specific domains such as mathoverflow.net help change the feature distribution that fastText learns, or is there another mechanism that reduces near‑duplication?
